grammar.title: Health: Asking for Help (Can / Have got / Question Formation)
grammar.titleTranslated: Salomatlik: yordam soʻrash (Can / Have got / Savol)
grammar.explanation:
Salomatlik holatlarida A1 grammatikasini birga ishlatamiz:
- **Can you help me?** — Menga yordam bera olasizmi? (Can)
- **I have got a headache.** — Menda bosh ogʻrigʻi bor. (have got)
- **What is the problem?** — Muammo nima? (savol)
- **I am taking medicine.** — Men dori ichyapman. (Hozirgi davomli zamon)
- **Call an ambulance!** — Tez yordam chaqiring! (Oʻzbekistonda tez yordam raqami: **103**)

rules.pattern: What's wrong? / What is the problem?

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri shakl: take → taking (hozirgi davomli zamon).
Toʻgʻri tartib: I + have got + a + headache.

exercises.prompt: Tuzating: She have got a cold.
Savolga oʻtkazing: You can help me.

dialogues.title: At the Doctor
dialogues.scenario: Bemor shifokorga boradi va muammosini aytadi.

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.text: I have got a headache and a fever.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: How long have you been sick?

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Open your mouth, please. Let me examine you.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: No. Take this medicine and rest.
lines.translation: Yoʻq. Mana bu dorini iching va dam oling.

comps.title: Health Builder
comps.passage: I am sick today. I have a headache and a fever. I go to the clinic. The doctor examines me. He writes a prescription. I take the medicine and rest. My mother makes hot tea for me. I drink water and sleep. I do not go to school today. Now I feel much better.
comps.passageTranslated: Men bugun kasalman. Boshim ogʻriyapti va isitmam bor. Men poliklinikaga boraman. Shifokor meni koʻrikdan oʻtkazadi. U retsept yozadi. Men dorini ichaman va dam olaman. Onam menga issiq choy tayyorlaydi. Men suv ichaman va uxlayman. Bugun maktabga bormayman. Endi oʻzimni ancha yaxshi his qilyapman.

questions.question: What is wrong with him?
questions.explanation: Matn: I have a headache and a fever.

questions.question: Where does he go?
questions.explanation: Matn: I go to the clinic.

questions.question: What does his mother make?
questions.explanation: Matn: My mother makes hot tea for me.

questions.question: Does he go to school today?
questions.explanation: Matn: Now I feel much better.

comps.title: Listening: At the Doctor
comps.passage: I don't feel well today. I have a headache and my throat hurts. I go to the doctor. The doctor gives me medicine. I must drink water and rest at home. Get well soon! My mother makes hot tea for me. I do not go to school today. I drink water and sleep in the afternoon. Now I feel much better.
comps.passageTranslated: Bugun oʻzimni yaxshi his qilmayapman. Boshim ogʻriyapti va tomogʻim ogʻriyapti. Men shifokorga boraman. Shifokor menga dori beradi. Men suv ichishim va uyda dam olishim kerak. Tezroq tuzaling! Onam menga issiq choy tayyorlaydi. Bugun maktabga bormayman. Men suv ichaman va tushdan keyin uxlayman. Endi oʻzimni ancha yaxshi his qilyapman.

questions.question: How does she feel?
questions.explanation: Matn: I don't feel well today.

questions.question: What hurts?
questions.explanation: Matn: I have a headache and my throat hurts.

questions.question: Who does she go to?
questions.explanation: Matn: I go to the doctor.

questions.question: What must she do?
questions.explanation: Matn: I must drink water and rest at home.

comps.title: At the Clinic
comps.passage: Ali is sick. He has got a headache and a cough. He goes to the clinic. The doctor examines him. The doctor writes a prescription. Ali buys medicine at the pharmacy. He goes home and rests. Now Ali is healthy.
comps.passageTranslated: Ali kasal. Uning boshi ogʻriyapti va yoʻtali bor. U poliklinikaga boradi. Shifokor uni koʻrikdan oʻtkazadi. Shifokor retsept yozadi. Ali dorixonadan dori sotib oladi. U uyga borib dam oladi. Endi Ali sogʻ.

questions.question: Where does Ali go?
questions.explanation: Matn: he goes to the clinic.

comps.title: Sara Has Toothache
comps.passage: Sara has got a toothache. She calls the clinic and makes an appointment. The nurse is kind. The doctor examines her tooth and gives her medicine. "Take one pill a day and rest," says the doctor. Sara feels better now. Her mother buys the medicine at the pharmacy. Sara rests at home and now she is healthy.
comps.passageTranslated: Saraning tishi ogʻriyapti. U poliklinikaga qoʻngʻiroq qilib, qabulga yoziladi. Hamshira mehribon. Shifokor uning tishini koʻrib, dori beradi. «Kuniga bitta tabletka iching va dam oling», — deydi shifokor. Endi Sara oʻzini yaxshiroq his qilyapti. Onasi dorini dorixonadan sotib oladi. Sara uyda dam oladi va endi u sogʻ.

questions.question: How does Sara feel now?
questions.questionTranslated: Sara hozir oʻzini qanday his qilyapti?
